criteria.auto: Low risk once its tests pass: comments, docs, tests or type declarations; a bug fix or a small feature confined to a few files; a refactor that keeps behaviour; or a backwards-compatible addition to a public API.
criteria.card: Needs a person even when its tests pass: it touches authentication, permissions, secrets or security checks; stores, migrates or deletes data; handles money; removes or changes existing public behaviour; changes build, CI, dependency or deployment configuration; or it is large (several hundred changed lines across many files).
